svg.text: Landing: both CTAs above the fold at 390 × 844; spine shrinks to a 20 px gutter.

text.font-family: Barlow, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Barlow, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Dyno lanes stack vertically; tachometers shrink; same states as desktop.

text.font-family: Barlow, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Barlow, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Recruiter: portrait + identity first. Sticky bottom CTA (CV + LinkedIn) on every page after the hero.

text.font-family: Barlow, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Barlow, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Terminal goes full screen; quick-command chips avoid typing on a phone keyboard.
